episodes.synopsis: Fifteen-year-old Ichigo Kurosaki has the uncanny ability to see ghosts, but otherwise lives an ordinary life. However, once a Shinigami named Rukia Kuchiki appears before him, everything changes.
episodes.title: The Day I Became a Shinigami

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki goes to his mother's grave with the rest of his family.
episodes.title: June 17, Memories in the Rain

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki battles against Grand Fisher.
episodes.title: Unbeatable Enemy

episodes.synopsis: While grudgingly attending Don Kanonji's show with the rest of his family, Ichigo Kurosaki is forced to fight a Hollow inadvertently created by Don Kanonji himself.
episodes.title: Assault on Trip at Sacred Ground!

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki meet Uryū Ishida, a Quincy.
episodes.title: The Legendary Quincy

episodes.synopsis: As Ichigo Kurosaki begins his duel with Uryū Ishida, Yasutora Sado gains a new power.
episodes.title: A Gentle Right Arm

episodes.synopsis: Orihime Inoue gains a new power in order to protect Tatsuki Arisawa.
episodes.title: Flower and Hollow

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki and Uryū Ishida work together to defeat a Menos Grande.
episodes.title: Back to Back, a Fight to the Death!

episodes.synopsis: Kon decides to run away from the Kurosaki Clinic as Soul Society comes after Rukia Kuchiki.
episodes.title: Kon's Great Plan

episodes.synopsis: Hachigen Ushōda helps Captain Suì-Fēng battle Baraggan Luisenbarn.
episodes.title: Hisagi and Tōsen, the Moment of Parting

episodes.synopsis: Baraggan Luisenbarn recalls his past as the King of Hueco Mundo before dying.
episodes.title: Crown of Lies, Baraggan's Grudge

episodes.synopsis: Love Aikawa and Rōjūrō Ōtoribashi battle against Coyote Starrk.
episodes.title: Power of the Soul! Los Lobos, Attack!

episodes.synopsis: Coyote Starrk and Captain Shunsui Kyōraku conclude their battle.
episodes.title: Stark, the Lone Battle

episodes.synopsis: As Tier Harribel falls unconscious from her wounds, she recalls her past.
episodes.title: Chain of Sacrifice, Halibel's Past

episodes.synopsis: As the situation begins to get desperate in the Fake Karakura Town, the battle with Yammy Llargo continues in Hueco Mundo.
episodes.title: The Hundred-Year Grudge! Hiyori's Revenge

episodes.synopsis: The captains in Hueco Mundo decide to send Ichigo Kurosaki back to Karakura Town.
episodes.title: Ichigo's Return! Protect Karakura Town

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki has a dream and tries to escape from it.
episodes.title: Side Story! Ichigo and the Magic Lamp

episodes.synopsis: As the battle with Yammy Llargo continues, Ichigo Kurosaki begins his return to Karakura Town.
episodes.title: The Final Trump Card! Ichigo, Towards the Decisive Battle

episodes.synopsis: As Captains Byakuya Kuchiki and Kenpachi Zaraki prepare to battle with each other, Yammy Llargo's anger makes him even stronger than before. Meanwhile, Kaname Tōsen reveals he has Hollowfication to Lieutenant Shūhei Hisagi and Captain Sajin Komamura.
episodes.title: Byakuya vs. Kenpachi?! The Melee Commences

episodes.synopsis: Kaname Tōsen reveals his true reasons for betraying Soul Society.
episodes.title: For the Sake of Justice?! The Man Who Deserted the Shinigami

episodes.synopsis: As Captain Sajin Komamura continues his battle with Kaname Tōsen, Shinji Hirako releases his Zanpakutō against Sōsuke Aizen.
episodes.title: Desperate Struggle with Aizen! Hirako, Shikai!

episodes.synopsis: The Shinigami and Visored vow to protect Ichigo Kurosaki and defeat Sōsuke Aizen.
episodes.title: All Out War! Aizen vs. Shinigami

episodes.synopsis: The Shinigami and Visored, attacking Sōsuke Aizen, are unable to defeat the treacherous captain.
episodes.title: Hitsugaya, Enraged! Blade of Hatred!

episodes.synopsis: Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto joins the battle against Sōsuke Aizen, only for his Zanpakutō's abilities to be sealed by Wonderweiss Margela.
episodes.title: Impossible to Attack? The Sealed Genryūsai!

episodes.synopsis: Sōsuke Aizen reveals to Ichigo Kurosaki that all of his battles have taken place exactly as he desired.
episodes.title: It's All a Trap... Engineered Bonds!

episodes.synopsis: As Sōsuke Aizen reveals more facts to Ichigo Kurosaki, Isshin Kurosaki joins the battle.
episodes.title: The Shocking Truth...The Mysterious Power Within Ichigo!

episodes.synopsis: As Ichigo Kurosaki and Gin Ichimaru battle, Sōsuke Aizen explains to Isshin Kurosaki about the true power of the Hōgyoku.
episodes.title: The Extending Blade?! Ichigo vs. Gin!

episodes.synopsis: The Shinigami in the Gotei 13 make a movie for the "Seireitei International Film Festival."
episodes.title: Film! Festival! Shinigami Film Festival!

episodes.synopsis: While visiting the World of the Living, Kuchiki Rukia comes across Kurumadani Zennosuke, the current Soul Reaper stationed in Karakura Town, being attacked by a mysterious masked man.
episodes.title: Theatre Opening Commemoration! The Hell Verse: Prologue

episodes.synopsis: The battle with Sōsuke Aizen continues as Aizen is transformed by the Hōgyoku.
episodes.title: Urahara Appears! Stop Aizen!

episodes.synopsis: As his transformation progresses, Sōsuke Aizen proves more and more resilient. Ichigo Kurosaki's strength fails to defeat Gin Ichimaru.
episodes.title: Ichigo Loses His Fighting Spirit!? Gin's Expectation!

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki begins training to learn the Final Getsuga Tenshō. Sōsuke Aizen and Gin Ichimaru arrive in Karakura Town.
episodes.title: The Final Getsuga Tenshō!? Ichigo's Training!

episodes.synopsis: The Soul Reaper Association hosts a New Year’s party in the Soul Society.
episodes.title: Real World and Shinigami! The New Year Special!

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki has another dream and tries to escape from it again.
episodes.title: Another Side Story! This Time's Enemy Is a Monster!?

episodes.synopsis: Lieutenants Shūhei Hisagi and Rangiku Matsumoto go on a mission, and Hisagi deludes himself into thinking that Rangiku likes him.
episodes.title: Delusion Roars! Hisagi, Towards the Hot Springs Inn!

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki stands his ground against Tensa Zangetsu, who fuses with Ichigo's inner Hollow.
episodes.title: For the Sake of Protecting! Ichigo vs. Tensa Zangetsu!

episodes.synopsis: As the Humans run away, Gin Ichimaru betrays Sōsuke Aizen.
episodes.title: Emergency Situation! Aizen, New Evolution!

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki emerges from his training and forces Sōsuke Aizen into battle away from Karakura Town.
episodes.title: Goodbye...Rangiku

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki uses the Final Getsuga Tenshō against Sōsuke Aizen.
episodes.title: Fierce Fighting Conclusion! Release, the Final Getsuga Tenshō!

episodes.synopsis: The aftermath of the battle with Sōsuke Aizen is shown.
episodes.title: Ichigo's Resolution! The Price of the Fierce Battle

episodes.synopsis: The continued adventures of Karakura-Raizer.
episodes.title: The Soul Detective: Karakuraizer Takes Off Again!

episodes.synopsis: Lieutenant Marechiyo Ōmaeda pretends to be the captain of the Second Division.
episodes.title: Inauguration! The Brand New 2nd Division Captain!

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki meets a member of the 11th Division named Seizo Harugasaki.
episodes.title: The Man Who Risks His Life in the 11th Division!

episodes.synopsis: Kon chases after a beautiful girl, while the rest of Karakura Town is threatened by a Hollow.
episodes.title: Kon Saw It! The Secret of a Beautiful Office Lady

episodes.synopsis: Lieutenant Yachiru Kusajishi encounters her old Shinigami friend and catches up with him.
episodes.title: Yachiru's Friend! The Shinigami of Justice Appears!

episodes.synopsis: Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya visits the Human World and visits Haru, an old lady he knew from his first assignment in the Human World.
episodes.title: Toshirō Hitsugaya's Holiday!

episodes.synopsis: One month after Sōsuke Aizen's defeat, as things are returning to normal, people begin to disappear in the Dangai.
episodes.title: Unusual Incident in Seireitei?! Gotei 13 Invading Army Arc!

episodes.synopsis: As Ichigo Kurosaki escapes from his detention, Kagerōza Inaba comes to collect Nozomi Kujō.
episodes.title: Renji vs. Rukia?! Battle With Comrades!

episodes.synopsis: As Uryū Ishida battles Kagerōza Inaba, Ichigo Kurosaki and Rukia Kuchiki attempt to escape from Seireitei.
episodes.title: Ichigo's Capture Net! Escape From Soul Society!

episodes.synopsis: While the real Gotei 13 have a meeting about the Reigai, Kon is tasked with looking after Nozomi Kujō.
episodes.title: Gotei 13, Gathering in the Real World!

episodes.synopsis: Captains Jūshirō Ukitake and Shunsui Kyōraku investigate the SRDI's records, while the real Gotei 13 officers encounter their Reigai counterparts.
episodes.title: Showdown of Mutual Self, Ikkaku vs. Ikkaku!

episodes.synopsis: As the Reigai continue their attack, Nozomi Kujō wanders around Karakura in search of something.
episodes.title: Clash! Rukia vs. Rukia!

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki defeats many Reigai while protecting Nozomi Kujō.
episodes.title: Protect Ichigo! Nozomi's Determination

episodes.synopsis: The captains return to Soul Society to confront Kagerōza Inaba.
episodes.title: Recapture Seireitei! The Captains Move!

episodes.synopsis: As Captain-Commander Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto fights the Reigai, Captain Byakuya Kuchiki encounters a Reigai of Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya.
episodes.title: For the Sake of the Believers! Byakuya vs. Hitsugaya!

episodes.synopsis: As the captains advance through Seireitei, Captain Tōshirō Hitsugaya encounters a Reigai of Lieutenant Momo Hinamori.
episodes.title: The Two Hinamori, Hitsugaya's Resolution

episodes.synopsis: Captains Sajin Komamura, Byakuya Kuchiki, and Genryūsai Shigekuni Yamamoto continue their battles with the Reigai.
episodes.title: Pride of the Kuchiki Family! Byakuya vs. Byakuya!

episodes.synopsis: The real members of the Gotei 13 arrive at Kagerōza Inaba's lair to challenge him.
episodes.title: Defeat Kageroza! Shinigami, All-Out War!

episodes.synopsis: Kagerōza Inaba struggles to recover from Captain Mayuri Kurotsuchi's attack, while his motives and Nozomi Kujō's identity are revealed.
episodes.title: The Forbidden Research...Nozomi's Hidden Secret!

episodes.synopsis: As the remaining members of the Gotei 13 try to recover, Nozomi Kujō decides she wants to help the others.
episodes.title: I Want to Live...! Nozomi's Zanpakutō

episodes.synopsis: Nozomi Kujō trains with Ichigo Kurosaki and the others while the Reigai assault the Human World once again.
episodes.title: For the Sake of Fighting! The Awakened Nozomi!

episodes.synopsis: Kujou Nozomi tries to join Ichigo and the others to fight the Reigai captains, but the other Soul Reapers tell her not to interfere.
episodes.title: The Most Evil Reigai, Appearing in the Real World!

episodes.synopsis: Head Captain Genryusai Yamamoto steps in to battle against the Reigai. Kurosaki Ichigo and Kujou Nozomi join the fight.
episodes.title: Destroy Nozomi!? Genryusai's Decision!

episodes.synopsis: Kujou Nozomi’s Zanpakuto breaks in the midst of trying to protect Yamamoto-Genryuusai Shigekuni from Inaba Kagerouza’s attack.
episodes.title: The Depleting Reiatsu! Ichigo, Death Struggle of the Soul!

episodes.synopsis: After being brought back to the Urahara Shop by Kisuke Urahara, Ichigo Kurosaki heads into the Dangai to retrieve his Reishi.
episodes.title: Hiding in the Dangai? Another Ichigo?!

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki, Kon, and Kisuke Urahara infiltrate Soul Society as Inaba begins to fuse with Nozomi Kujō.
episodes.title: Pursue Kageroza! Technological Development Department, Infiltration!

episodes.synopsis: As Yoruichi Shihōin and the captains battle the Reigai, Ichigo Kurosaki, Kon, and Kisuke Urahara go in search of Kagerōza Inaba's lab.
episodes.title: The Developer of the Modified Souls

episodes.synopsis: Urahara Kisuke and Kon find Ouko Yushima, the man behind Kageroza’s invasion. Finding traces of Kageroza’s blood nearby, the two follow the trail.
episodes.title: Kon's Thoughts, Nozomi's Thoughts

episodes.synopsis: The Gotei 13 battle the Reigai, while the combined form of Inaba and Nozomi Kujō fights off a Hollowfied Ichigo and his friends.
episodes.title: Protect Ichigo! The Bonds of Friends!

episodes.synopsis: As the merged Inaba Nozomi Kujō is confronted, the captains and lieutenants battle the Reigai.
episodes.title: Reigai vs. Original, The Fierce Fighting for Gambled Pride!

episodes.synopsis: As the captains and lieutenants fight against the Reigai, Ichigo Kurosaki uses his restored powers to fight the fused form of Kagerōza Inaba and Nozomi Kujō.
episodes.title: Invading Army Arc, Final Conclusion!

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki gradually loses his remaining powers and bids farewell to Rukia Kuchiki.
episodes.title: Thank You

episodes.synopsis: Seventeen months later, Ichigo Kurosaki continues living life as a normal teenage high school student in Karakura Town.
episodes.title: 3rd Year High School Student! Dressed Up, and a New Chapter Begins!

episodes.synopsis: Kurosaki Ichigo’s boss Unagiya Ikumi shows up and drags him back to the office, where he meets a man called Kugo Ginjo.
episodes.title: A Dispute in School!? Ichigo and Uryū, Fight Together!

episodes.synopsis: After Ichigo Kurosaki and Orihime Inoue visit Uryū Ishida in the hospital, Keigo Asano is attacked.
episodes.title: Uryū is Attacked, A Threat Draws Near the Friends!

episodes.synopsis: Ginjou Kuugo tells Kurosaki Ichigo of his goal to restore his lost Soul Reaper powers, as well as demonstrating his own unique power.
episodes.title: The Man with the Fullbring Ability: Kūgo Ginjō

episodes.synopsis: Kurosaki Ichigo has a day to decide whether to regain his lost Soul Reaper powers or not.
episodes.title: A Crisis Sneaking up on the Kurosaki Family!? Ichigo's Confusion!

episodes.synopsis: Kurosaki Ichigo begins training, his first session is to fight and win against Mr. Pork
episodes.title: Power of the Substitute Badge, Ichigo's 'Pride'!

episodes.synopsis: Inoue Orihime is suddenly stopped and asked to die by a man named Shishigawara Moe.
episodes.title: Next Target, The Devil's Hand Aims at Orihime!

episodes.synopsis: Tsuskishima pretends to impale Orihime's chest and leaves her. Although Orihime suffered no cuts, she starts having a vague idea that Tsukishima was her friend. Unwilling to worry Ichigo about what happened, she only tells Chad about Tsukishima. Aware that Orihime is hiding information from, Ichigo goes back to to Xcution headquarters to continue his training to help his friends.
episodes.title: The Man Who Killed the Shinigami Substitute!? Tsukishima Makes His Move

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki continues his training with Xcution, as they struggle to convince Jackie Tristan to help.
episodes.title: Fullbring, The Detested Power!

episodes.synopsis: As Jackie Tristan and Ichigo Kurosaki train in the fish tank, Shūkurō Tsukishima arrives in Xcution's hideout.
episodes.title: Tsukishima Attacks! The Training Has Been Thwarted

episodes.synopsis: As Shūkurō Tsukishima arrives at Xcution, a battle ensues.
episodes.title: Ichigo, Mastering the Fullbring!

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki fights Kūgo Ginjō in the Game Space.
episodes.title: Ichigo vs. Ginjō! To the Game's Space

episodes.synopsis: New year celebrations in Soul Society include a kite-flying contest and Rukia performing a celebration dance.
episodes.title: Shinigami at War! New Year in Seireitei Special!

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki continues his training with Kūgo Ginjō, resulting in him completing his Fullbring.
episodes.title: Friend or Foe!? Ginjō's True Intentions!

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo trains with his Fullbring. Chad and Orihime investigate Tsukishima and engage in battle.
episodes.title: Tsukishima's Ability, the Danger is Drawing Near!

episodes.synopsis: Uryū leaves the hospital to investigate a Reiatsu that is appearing everywhere. Ichigo's friends and family, as well as the members of Xcution except for Ginjō, have been cut by Tsukishima.
episodes.title: Clash!? Xcution attacks Ginjō

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo and Kūgo catch their breath at a secret hideout and formulate a plan. They go to Tsukishima's mansion and engage in battle.
episodes.title: The Sorrowful Battle! Ichigo vs. Sado & Orihime

episodes.synopsis: As Ichigo Kurosaki begins his battle with Shūkurō Tsukishima, Uryū Ishida arrives, and Kūgo Ginjō is cut by Tsukishima.
episodes.title: Ichigo vs Uryū!? Who is the Traitor!?

episodes.synopsis: Stripped of his Fullbring, the powerless Ichigo Kurosaki is stabbed by Rukia Kuchiki and has his Shinigami powers returned to him.
episodes.title: A New Appearance! The Gotei 13, Arrives!

episodes.synopsis: The 13 Court Guard Squad Soul Reapers share their Spirit Energy to restore Ichigo Kurosaki’s lost powers.
episodes.title: Revival! Substitute Shinigami: Ichigo Kurosaki!

episodes.synopsis: The Soul Reapers take on the Xcution members in one-on-one battles.
episodes.title: Fierce Fight! Shinigami vs. XCUTION!

episodes.synopsis: The battle between Kuchiki Byakuya and Tsukishima Shuukurou escalates as they both push their powers to the limit.
episodes.title: Desperate Struggle!? Byakuya's Troubled Memories

episodes.synopsis: As the battle between Ichigo Kurosaki, Uryū Ishida, and Kūgo Ginjō intensifies, the truth behind the Substitute Shinigami Badge surfaces.
episodes.title: Ichigo vs. Ginjō! Secret of the Substitute Badge

episodes.synopsis: Ichigo Kurosaki and Ginjo Kugo both release their Bankai to settle the score.
episodes.title: Changing History, Unchanging Heart
